name: Jason Calacanis
what_they_do: Angel investor; founder and CEO of LAUNCH (LAUNCH Accelerator, Founder University, The Syndicate); host of This Week in Startups and co-host of All-In podcast
stage: Idea to MVP via Founder University ($25K or $125K); MVP to scale via LAUNCH Accelerator ($125K); growth via The Syndicate ($250K+). Yes, invests at idea stage through Founder University.
check_size: $25K (Founder University pre-accelerator) to $125K (accelerator); $250K+ via The Syndicate. Secondary sources list $100K-$500K.
geography: USA-based programs; global reach via Founder University; MENA and Japan programs
outreach_rule: Apply for funding via the LAUNCH form (forms.launch.co/apply). Signal profile quotes him: founders with traction for the accelerator, $1m+ ARR for the syndicate; 'please, build something!' rather than coffee to discuss ideas.
notes: Founder University is the idea-to-MVP track; LAUNCH invests in ~100 startups a year; syndicate has 10,000+ backers. Early investor in Uber, Robinhood, Calm. Prefers something built over an idea-only pitch, even for the idea-stage program.

name: Sahil Lavingia
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of Gumroad; angel investor via SHL Capital rolling fund
stage: Pre-seed and seed (Mercury investor database and VCSheet); also listed for Series A on VCSheet
check_size: $100K-$250K (Mercury investor database and VCSheet; secondary sources)
email_or_form: unknown (Mercury DB lists https://shl.vc/apply, but shl.vc now shows a 'domain for sale' page as of 2026-09-02)
outreach_rule: Quoted on Mercury DB: 'For outreach, I need a deck, but a product I can play with is even better.' Invests in most industries outside of music, DTC, and gambling. The public apply form URL is dead; no replacement form verified.
notes: ~30 angel investments incl. Clubhouse, Figma, Notion, Vercel, HelloSign. Favors profitable, calm, small-but-great startups; hard-tech that solves human problems; execution over abstract potential. Personal site does not list investing info.

notes: Early investor in Airbnb, Anthropic, Anduril, Coinbase, Figma, Notion, OpenAI, Perplexity, Stripe, etc. Focus on AI/ML, generative AI, longevity biotech, enterprise. 218 investments on Signal record.
